values.title: Notice on the 2026 licensed pharmacist professional qualification exam registration
values.summary: Registration runs from August 5 through August 28. Western medicine applicants need pharmacy, Chinese medicine, or related education and the required work years; submit diploma, work certificate, recent ID photo, and application commitment. Work-year calculation closes on December 31, 2026.

values.title: 2026 licensed pharmacist exam registration notice published
values.body: The registration channel opens on August 5. Once the exam level and subject category are confirmed, they cannot be changed.
